sloka: योजनानि महावेगैः कृतानि त्वरितैस्ततः ।पञ्चमेन तथा चाह्ना प्लवगैः क्षिप्रकारिभिः ॥६-२२-७०॥।।
transliteration: yojanāni mahāvegaiḥ kṛtāni tvaritaistataḥ ।pañcamena tathā cāhnā plavagaiḥ kṣiprakāribhiḥ ॥6-22-70॥।।

translations.english: Similarly, on the fifth day the Vanaras endowed with great impetus built twenty three yojanas and crossed Mount Suvela.
